verses.geez:
ወይቤለኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በውእቶን ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ቅር ፡ ለከ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ [ዘእብን ፡] ከመ ፡ እለ ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡
                  ወዕረግ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወግበር ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ዕፅ ።
verses.translation: At that time the Lord said to me, Hew for thyself two stone tables as the first, and come up to me into the mountain, and thou shalt make for thyself an ark of wood.

translations.lxx: At that time the Lord said to me, Hew for thyself two stone tables as the first, and come up to me into the mountain, and thou shalt make for thyself an ark of wood.
translations.kjv: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
translations.ron: "Atunci mi-a zis Domnul: Ciopleşte-ţi două table de piatră, ca şi cele dintâi, şi suie-te la Mine în munte şi-ţi fă un chivot de lemn;

verses.geez:
ወእጽሕፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቶን ፡ ጽላት ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ ጽላት ፡ እለ ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡ ቀጥቀጥከ
                  ፡ ወደዮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ታቦት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt write upon the tables the words which were on the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt put them into the ark.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt write upon the tables the words which were on the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt put them into the ark.
translations.kjv: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
translations.ron: Că Eu am să scriu pe tablele acelea cuvintele ce au fost pe tablele cele dintâi, pe care le-ai sfărâmat, iar tu să le pui în chivot.

verses.geez:
ወገበርኩ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ ወወቀርኩ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ ዘእብን ፡ ከመ ፡ እለ ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡
                  ወዐረጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ወውስተ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ውእቶን ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ ጽላት ።
verses.translation: So I made an ark of boards of incorruptible wood, and I hewed tables of stone like the first, and I went up to the mountain, and the two tables were in my hand.

translations.lxx: So I made an ark of boards of incorruptible wood, and I hewed tables of stone like the first, and I went up to the mountain, and the two tables were in my hand.
translations.kjv: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
translations.ron: Am făcut atunci un chivot din lemn de salcâm, am cioplit două table de piatră, ca şi cele dintâi, şi m-am suit în munte cu cele două table în mâinile mele.

verses.geez:
ወጸሐፈ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቶን ፡ ጽላት ፡ በከመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ዘቀዲሙ ፡ ዓሥሩ ፡ ቃ[ለ] ፡ ዘነገረነ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ በማእከለ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.translation: And he wrote upon the tables according to the first writing the ten commandments, which the Lord spoke to you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire, and the Lord gave them to me.

translations.lxx: And he wrote upon the tables according to the first writing the ten commandments, which the Lord spoke to you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire, and the Lord gave them to me.
translations.kjv: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
translations.ron: Iar El a scris pe table, cum fusese scris şi pe cele dintâi, cele zece porunci pe care vi le spusese Domnul pe munte din mijlocul focului, în ziua adunării, şi mi le-a dat Domnul mie;

verses.geez:
ወወደይክዎን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ለውእቶን ፡ ጽላት ፡ እለ ፡ ገበርኩ ፡ ወነበራ ፡ ህየ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዘኒ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tables into the ark which I had made; and there they were, as the Lord commanded me.

translations.lxx: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tables into the ark which I had made; and there they were, as the Lord commanded me.
translations.kjv: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
translations.ron: Iar eu m-am întors şi m-am pogorât din munte şi am pus tablele în chivotul pe care-l făcusem, ca să stea acolo, cum îmi poruncise Domnul.

verses.geez:
ወግዕዙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምነ ፡ ቤሮሱ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ኢያቅም ፡ ዘሚሳዴ ፡ ወበህየ ፡ ሞተ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወተቀብረ ፡
                  በህየ ፡ ወተሠይመ ፡ በህየ ፡ አል ዓዛር ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ካህን ፡ ህየንቴሁ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel departed from Beeroth of the sons of Jakim to Misadai: there Aaron died, and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son was priest in his stead.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel departed from Beeroth of the sons of Jakim to Misadai: there Aaron died, and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son was priest in his stead.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
translations.ron: Apoi au plecat fiii lui Israel din Beerot-Bene-Iaacan la Mosera. Acolo a murit Aaron şi a fost îngropat acolo şi în locul lui s-a făcut preot Eleazar, fiul lui.

verses.geez: ወእምህየ ፡ ግዕዙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገድገድ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ገድገድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዔጤቦታ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘአንቅዕተ ፡ ማይ ።
verses.translation: Thence they departed to Gadgad; and from Gadgad to Etebatha, a land wherein are torrents of water.

translations.lxx: Thence they departed to Gadgad; and from Gadgad to Etebatha, a land wherein are torrents of water.
translations.kjv: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
translations.ron: De acolo am plecat la Gudgod şi din Gudgod la Iotbata, în pământul unde sunt cursuri de apă.

verses.geez:
ወበውእቶን ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ፈለጦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይጹሩ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ወከመ ፡ ይቁሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይግበሩ ፡ ወይጸልዩ ፡ በስመ ፡ ዚአሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand near before the Lord, to minister and bless in his name to this day.

translations.lxx: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand near before the Lord, to minister and bless in his name to this day.
translations.kjv: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea a ales Domnul seminţia lui Levi, ca să poarte chivotul legământului Domnului, să stea înaintea Domnului, să-I slujească, să se roage şi să-I binecuvânteze numele Lui, cum face până în ziua de astăzi.

verses.geez:
ወበበይነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ክፍለ ፡ ወርስተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አኀዊ[ሆሙ] ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ
                  ፡ ክፍሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎ ።
verses.translation: Therefore the Levites have no part nor inheritance among their brethren; the Lord himself is their inheritance, as he said to them.

translations.lxx: Therefore the Levites have no part nor inheritance among their brethren; the Lord himself is their inheritance, as he said to them.
translations.kjv: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
translations.ron: De aceea n-are levitul parte şi moştenire cu fraţii săi, căci moştenirea lui este Domnul, cum i-a spus Domnul Dumnezeul tău.

verses.geez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ቆምኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ፵ዕለተ ፡ ወ፵ሌሊተ ፡ ወሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በውእቶንሂ ፡ መዋዕል ፡
                  ወኀደገክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኢያጥፍአክሙ ።
verses.translation: And I remained in the mount forty days and forty nights: and the Lord heard me at that time also, and the Lord would not destroy you.

translations.lxx: And I remained in the mount forty days and forty nights: and the Lord heard me at that time also, and the Lord would not destroy you.
translations.kjv: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
translations.ron: Deci am stat eu pe munte, ca şi întâia oară, patruzeci de zile şi patruzeci de nopţi; şi m-a ascultat Domnul şi de astă dată şi n-a mai vrut Domnul să te piardă,

verses.geez:
ወይቤለኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሑር ፡ ወንግር ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወይባኡ ፡ ወይትወረሱ ፡ ምድረ ፡ እንተ ፡
                  መሐልኩ ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሀቦሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to me, Go, set out before this people, and let them go in and inherit the land, which I sware to their fathers to give to them.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to me, Go, set out before this people, and let them go in and inherit the land, which I sware to their fathers to give to them.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
translations.ron: Ci mi-a zis Domnul: Scoală şi mergi înaintea poporului acestuia, ca să intre şi să moştenească pământul pentru care M-am jurat părinţilor lor să li-l dau.

verses.geez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ምንተ ፡ ይፈቅድ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እንበለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትፍርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክከ ፡ ወትሑር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍና[ዊሁ ፡] ወከመ ፡ ታፍቅሮ ፡ ወታምልኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብከ ፡
                  ወበኵሉ ፡ ነፍስከ ፤
verses.translation: And now, Israel, what does the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, and to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;

translations.lxx: And now, Israel, what does the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, and to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;
translations.kjv: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
translations.ron: Aşadar, Israele, ce cere de la tine Domnul Dumnezeul tău? - Numai aceasta: să te temi de Domnul Dumnezeul tău, să umbli în toate căile Lui, să-L iubeşti şi să slujeşti Domnului Dumnezeului tău, din toată inima ta şi din tot sufletul tău;

verses.geez:
ወትዕቀብ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእ ግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወኵነኔሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡
                  ይኩንከ ።
verses.translation: to keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and his ordinances, all that I charge thee to-day, that it may be well with thee?

translations.lxx: to keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, and his ordinances, all that I charge thee to-day, that it may be well with thee?
translations.kjv: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
translations.ron: Să păzeşti poruncile Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi hotărârile Lui pe care ţi le spun eu astăzi, ca să-ţi fie bine.

verses.geez: ወናሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወሰማየ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወምድር ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘውስቴታ ።
verses.translation: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens belong to the Lord thy God, the earth and all things that are in it.

translations.lxx: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens belong to the Lord thy God, the earth and all things that are in it.
translations.kjv: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’s thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
translations.ron: Iată, al Domnului Dumnezeului tău este cerul şi cerurile cerurilor, pământul şi toate cele de pe el.

verses.geez:
ወዳእሙ ፡ አበዊክሙ ፡ አብደረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያፈቅሮሙ ፡ ወኀርየ ፡ ዘርኦሙ ፡ እምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ኪያክሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ
                  ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: Only the Lord chose your fathers to love them, and he chose out their seed after them, even you, beyond all nations, as at this day.

translations.lxx: Only the Lord chose your fathers to love them, and he chose out their seed after them, even you, beyond all nations, as at this day.
translations.kjv: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
translations.ron: Dar numai pe părinţii tăi i-a primit Domnul şi i-a iubit şi v-a ales pe voi, sămânţa lor de după ei, din toate popoarele, cum vedeţi astăzi.

verses.geez: ወግዝሩ ፡ እከዮ ፡ ለልብክሙ ፡ ወኢታግዝፉ ፡ ክሳደክሙ ፡ እንከ ።
verses.translation: Therefore ye shall circumcise the hardness of your heart, and ye shall not harden your neck.

translations.lxx: Therefore ye shall circumcise the hardness of your heart, and ye shall not harden your neck.
translations.kjv: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
translations.ron: Deci să tăiaţi împrejur inima voastră şi de acum înainte să nu mai fiţi tari la cerbice;

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላከ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ወእግዚአ ፡ አጋእስት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ዐቢይ ፡ ወጽኑዕ ፡ ወግሩም ፡ ዘኢያደሉ ፡ ለገጽ ፡ ወኢይነሥእ ፡ ሕልያነ ።
verses.translation: For the Lord your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great, and strong, and terrible God, who does not accept persons, nor will he by any means accept a bribe:

translations.lxx: For the Lord your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great, and strong, and terrible God, who does not accept persons, nor will he by any means accept a bribe:
translations.kjv: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
translations.ron: Că Domnul Dumnezeul vostru este Dumnezeul dumnezeilor şi Stăpânul stăpânilor, Dumnezeu mare şi puternic şi minunat, Care nu caută la faţă, nici nu ia mită;

verses.geez: ወይገብር ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ለግዩር ፡ ወለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ፡ ወለእቤር ፡ ወያፈቅሮ ፡ ለግዩር ፡ ወይሁቦ ፡ ሲሳዮ ፡ ወዐራዞ ።
verses.translation: executing judgment for the stranger and orphan and widow, and he loves the stranger to give him food and raiment.

translations.lxx: executing judgment for the stranger and orphan and widow, and he loves the stranger to give him food and raiment.
translations.kjv: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
translations.ron: Care face dreptate orfanului şi văduvei şi iubeşte pe pribeag şi-i dă pâine şi hrană.

verses.geez: ወአፍቅር ዎ ፡ ለግዩር ፡ እስመ ፡ አንትሙኒ ፡ ግዩራነ ፡ ኮንክሙ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall love the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

translations.lxx: And ye shall love the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.ron: Să iubiţi şi voi pe pribeag, că şi voi aţi fost pribegi în pământul Egiptului.

verses.geez: ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ፍርሆ ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ለባሕቲቱ ፡ አምልኮ ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ትልዎ ፡ [ወበስመ ፡ ዚአሁ ፡ መሐል ፡]፡
verses.translation: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt cleave to him, and shalt swear by his name.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt cleave to him, and shalt swear by his name.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
translations.ron: De Domnul Dumnezeul tău să te temi, numai Lui să-I slujeşti, de El să te lipeşti şi cu numele Lui să te juri.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ትምክሕትሕሙ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ለከ ፡ ዐቢያተ ፡ ወእላንተ ፡ ክቡራተ ፡ ዘርእያ ፡
                  አዕይንቲከ ።
verses.translation: He is thy boast, and he is thy God, who has wrought in the midst of thee these great and glorious things, which thine eyes have seen.

translations.lxx: He is thy boast, and he is thy God, who has wrought in the midst of thee these great and glorious things, which thine eyes have seen.
translations.kjv: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
translations.ron: El este lauda ta şi El este Dumnezeul tău, Cel ce a făcut cu tine acele lucruri mari şi înfricoşătoare pe care le-au văzut ochii tăi.

verses.geez:
በሰብዓ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ ወረዱ ፡ አበዊከ ፡ ውስ ተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወይእዜሰ ፡ ገብረከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ከዋክብተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ በብዝኅ ።
verses.translation: With seventy souls your fathers went down into Egypt; but the Lord thy God has made thee as the stars of heaven in multitude.

translations.lxx: With seventy souls your fathers went down into Egypt; but the Lord thy God has made thee as the stars of heaven in multitude.
translations.kjv: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
translations.ron: Şaptezeci şi cinci de suflete erau părinţii tăi când au venit în Egipt, iar acum Domnul Dumnezeul tău ţi-a sporit numărul ca stelele cerului".
